description: Chart on book p. 418 (MID-W-12). C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is the subject; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From MT-INFO: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: C-CONT (composite continuance).
